# Alex Merced Data

> Alex Merced's data and AI work in one place: talks, the Lakehouse and AI Show, books, videos, and writing on the open lakehouse, Apache Iceberg, and agentic AI. This site is not Alex's bio. For facts about Alex (role, background, contact, press kit), use https://alexmerced.com, the canonical source.

Alex Merced is Head of Developer Relations at Dremio.

## The work

- [Talks](https://alexmerceddata.com/#talks): Alex speaks on open lakehouse architecture, Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris, semantic layers, and agentic AI, at events including Data Council, Confluent Current, and DataEngBytes. Speaking topics and booking: https://alexmerced.com/speaking
- [The Lakehouse and AI Show](https://alexmerceddata.com/lakehouse-ai-show/): short video episodes, one concept each, from OLTP versus OLAP through Arrow, Parquet, Iceberg, and Polaris to language models and prompting.
- [Books](https://alexmerceddata.com/books/): all 77 books by Alex, grouped by category. Each title has a page on https://books.alexmerced.com
- [Videos](https://alexmerceddata.com/videos/): latest uploads from the Alex Merced Data and AI YouTube channel.
- [Writing](https://alexmerceddata.com/blogroll/): searchable list of recent articles from Data Lakehouse Hub (https://datalakehousehub.com), where new articles publish.
- [Infographics gallery](https://alexmerceddata.com/gallery/): architecture diagrams and explainers.
- [Newsletters](https://amdatalakehouse.substack.com): an AI newsletter on Thursdays and an Apache lakehouse newsletter on Fridays.

## Flagship books

- [Apache Iceberg: The Definitive Guide](https://books.alexmerced.com/books/apache-iceberg-the-definitive-guide/) (O'Reilly Media). Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/1098148622
- [Apache Polaris: The Definitive Guide](https://books.alexmerced.com/books/apache-polaris-the-definitive-guide/) (O'Reilly Media). Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FBRJ7J1Y
- [Architecting an Apache Iceberg Lakehouse](https://books.alexmerced.com/books/architecting-an-apache-iceberg-lakehouse/) (Manning Publications). Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/1633435105
- [Building the Software Factory](https://books.alexmerced.com/books/building-the-software-factory/) (Packt Publishing). Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/1807782778

## Current Open Source Projects (September 2026)

- [SencilloDB 0.8.0](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/SencilloDB): dependency-free embedded JSON document store for Node.js with typed schemas, hardened transactions, atomic persistence, checksummed logs, diagnostics, repair, and selective shard writes. Published on npm.
- [IceFrame](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/iceframe): DataFrame-style Apache Iceberg library. Version 0.13.0 is published on PyPI; 0.14.0 is the active development line with MCP 2.1, full-package typing, async and ingestion corrections, query explain, CDC, packaging, and security hardening.
- [Pangolin 0.8.0](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/Pangolin): Rust Iceberg REST catalog with multi-tenancy, branching, RBAC, OIDC, encrypted credentials, audit logging, a management UI, CLIs, and a Python SDK.
- [MagAgent 1.4.0](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/MagAgent): memory-first personal agent that remembers you across sessions in Git-backed Markdown. 1.4.0 adds per-run memory evidence, review-gated team memory, and expiring approval grants. Published on PyPI.
- [Mag Command Center 1.0.0](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/MagCommandCenter/releases/tag/v1.0.0): desktop cockpit for MagAgent with runs, approvals, graphs, and memory in one window. First stable release for Linux, macOS, and Windows; installers are unsigned. Requires MagAgent 1.4.0.
- [MagGraph 0.4.1](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/MagGraph): graph-shaped agent memory stored as Markdown in Git, with a Rust core and Python bindings.
- [Loro 0.22.0](https://github.com/alexmerced-oss/loro): governed agent harness for data and platform teams with verified identity, tamper-evident audit, and lakehouse-native tools. 0.22.0 adds multi-turn context with audited compaction plus experimental OIDC sign-in, multi-user mode, a container sandbox, and run evidence export.
- [Merced AI 0.8.0](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/merced-ai): agent broker that keeps one portable agent identity across the harnesses you already use and reports what each one drops. 0.8.0 adds ACP client and server support, worktree-per-bot group runs, cross-harness evals, and an experimental A2A endpoint.
- [Open Agent Profile](https://github.com/alexmerced-oss/open-agent-profile): specification 1.0, support libraries 1.0.5 for Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Java. Portable agent identity, authority, and learned state.
- [Agentic Graph Specification](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/agentic-graph-spec): specification 1.0, support libraries 1.0.4 for Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Java. Portable bounded work graphs with cross-language validation and planning.
- [Agent Approval Interchange Specification](https://github.com/alexmerced-oss/agent-approval-interchange-spec): specification 1.0 for exact, durable, transport-neutral human approvals. Python support library 0.2.0 (adds a shared durable file store); TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Java support libraries 0.1.0.
